summary: HF3FS now represents a DeepSeek-V4 LogicalHostPool primary anchor with a one-byte marker page, preserving primary-key existence gating while physical KV payloads remain in the existing named v2 side pools. Non-positive page sizes for non-logical pools now fail with a clear ValueError.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the change, an actual LogicalHostPool produced bytes_per_page=0 and HiCacheHF3FS initialization raised ZeroDivisionError; raw output: reports/j-66d681f485b1/raw/failing_before.txt.

Four focused cases passed: factory marker geometry, mock-HF3FS marker write/existence/read round trip, preservation of zero geometry for an invalid physical pool, and explicit rejection of non-positive page sizes.
Five HF3FS utility and logical-anchor tests passed; raw output: reports/j-66d681f485b1/raw/hf3fs_tests.txt.
The prepared interpreter does not contain black or ruff. git diff --check passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reproduced failure occurs during CPU-side backend geometry initialization before GPU execution. The regression exercises the actual factory and mock HF3FS data/metadata paths; no GPU-kernel claim is made.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4 model weights were not available, so a full model-serving reproduction was not performed.
No deployed HF3FS cluster was available; storage I/O was validated with the repository's Hf3fsMockClient and local metadata implementation.
The available gfx950 GPU was not relevant to the initialization-time division-by-zero and was not used; distributed behavior remains unverified.
The prepared interpreter lacks black and ruff, so formatter checks could not run; git diff --check passed.
